about_the_game:
🔥 Welcome to Afterheat

A harsh survival experience in a scorched world forgotten by time.

The Earth as we knew it is gone. Extreme global warming has transformed the planet into a lifeless desert. Oceans have dried up, cities lie in ruins, and you are one of the last known survivors. Alone in an endless heatwave, you must scavenge, adapt, and survive.

⚙️ Key Features:

🌅 Post-Apocalyptic Desert World

Explore a vast open-world shaped by heat and decay. From sun-scorched dunes to the ghostly remnants of civilization, every step is a fight for survival.

🧭 Deep Survival Systems

Manage your thirst, hunger, body temperature, and exhaustion. Shelter and hydration aren’t luxuries—they’re your lifelines.

🐺 Dynamic Wildlife Encounters

Navigate a fragile ecosystem twisted by climate collapse. Beware predators that roam the wastelands.

🛠️ Crafting & Resource Management

Scavenge for materials, craft tools, and build makeshift shelters to survive searing heat and deadly sandstorms.

🌡️ Real-Time Heat & Weather System

Endure blistering days and freezing nights with a fully dynamic weather and temperature system that directly affects gameplay.

🧠 A Solo Story of Survival & Mystery

Uncover what’s left of the old world. Piece together forgotten history—and maybe find a reason to keep going.

🚧 Under Development

Afterheat is currently in development by a solo developer. All screenshots and visuals are from an early prototype stage and do not reflect the final quality of the game. Expect significant visual and structural improvements by the time it enters Early Access, including more detailed environments, unique art assets, and expanded content.

Screenshots will be updated regularly as development progresses.

❤️ Help Shape the Game

This is a passion project, built with care and focus on player experience. Your feedback will help shape its future. If you’re interested in Afterheat, please consider adding it to your wishlist!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 or AMD Radeon R9 380
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580

short_description: Survive in a post-apocalyptic desert scorched by extreme global warming. Explore, scavenge, and stay alive in a world where water is rare, the heat is deadly, and you're completely alone.
